sites.dev: Menter Môn with Isle of Anglesey County Council

txt.en: Has planning permission. Its outline business case was approved in September 2026 and it is aiming for North Wales Growth Deal funding. It would make about 9,000 tonnes of green hydrogen over 15 years.
txt.cy: Mae ganddo ganiatâd cynllunio. Cymeradwywyd ei achos busnes amlinellol ym mis Medi 2026 ac mae’n anelu at gyllid Bargen Twf Gogledd Cymru. Byddai’n cynhyrchu tua 9,000 tunnell o hydrogen gwyrdd dros 15 mlynedd.

txt.en: Part of the HyNet cluster: blue hydrogen from natural gas at Stanlow, with the CO₂ captured and stored under Liverpool Bay. Approved plans include a 60 km CO₂ pipeline from Cheshire to the Point of Ayr terminal in Flintshire. The hydrogen plant’s current investment status was not confirmed for this map.
txt.cy: Rhan o glwstwr HyNet: hydrogen glas o nwy naturiol yn Stanlow, gyda’r CO₂ yn cael ei ddal a’i storio o dan Fae Lerpwl. Mae’r cynlluniau a gymeradwywyd yn cynnwys piblinell CO₂ 60 km o Swydd Gaer i derfynfa Point of Ayr yn Sir y Fflint. Ni chadarnhawyd statws buddsoddi presennol y gwaith hydrogen ar gyfer y map hwn.

sites.dev: National Gas, Centrica, Equinor and SSE Thermal

txt.en: A consortium of National Gas, Centrica, Equinor and SSE Thermal is preparing a bid for government support under the hydrogen transport and storage business model, as reported in March 2026. Project Union: East Coast would link into it. Whether the bid has succeeded was not confirmed.
txt.cy: Mae consortiwm o National Gas, Centrica, Equinor ac SSE Thermal yn paratoi cynnig am gymorth y llywodraeth dan y model busnes cludo a storio hydrogen, yn ôl adroddiadau ym mis Mawrth 2026. Byddai Project Union: East Coast yn cysylltu â hi. Ni chadarnhawyd a yw’r cynnig wedi llwyddo.

sites.dev: National Gas (with Northern Gas Networks and Cadent)

txt.en: The first phase of a proposed national hydrogen network: about 300 miles of underground pipeline from Teesside through Yorkshire and the Humber into the East Midlands, part of up to 1,500 miles nationally. Ofgem confirmed £164 million in November 2025 for three National Gas projects, including this one. The line on the map is an indicative corridor, not the surveyed route.
txt.cy: Cam cyntaf rhwydwaith hydrogen cenedlaethol arfaethedig: tua 300 milltir o biblinell danddaearol o Teesside drwy Swydd Efrog a’r Humber i Ddwyrain Canolbarth Lloegr, yn rhan o hyd at 1,500 milltir yn genedlaethol. Cadarnhaodd Ofgem £164 miliwn ym mis Tachwedd 2025 ar gyfer tri phrosiect National Gas, gan gynnwys hwn. Cyfeiriad bras yw’r llinell ar y map, nid y llwybr a arolygwyd.
